proposedBellaRules.source: Safely qualified physical video file own descriptor MDFL:SampleRate, preserving positive original numerator/denominator and supported typed context under Avid name SampleRate. proposedBellaRules.presentationAndRetention: Share existing preserved rate and pure interpreter with Duration. Late familiar labels and exact numeric sorting; no duplicate permanent pair/string solely for this column or label-parsing for maths/sorting. Nominal30 does not replace29.97. Keep compact type/source/availability and release scratch. Uncommon label precision remains existing presentation follow-up.
proposedBellaRules.buildingBlocks: Small C++17 fixed-width fraction/value helpers and checked QtEndian decoding. No new dependency, separate rate parser or additional media read solely for this column.
proposedBellaRules.existingPriority: Usable MDB first; eligible usable own-file header rate only if MDB unusable and header independently already read. No new open or MDB Duration repair from isolated header Frame Rate. Full source table remains deferred.

bellaProposal.validation: Require positive numerator and denominator for a usable rate, distinguish missing/damaged fromzero. Use compact availability; do not drop physical file or unrelated good fields.
bellaProposal.storage: Reuse original SampleRate numerator/denominator and source/type context already retained for Duration; derive interpreted rational transiently. No permanent duplicate rate, native graph, codec-name FPS parse, rounded label, or additional whole-file read.

bellaProposal.frameUnits: No unconditional interlace halving or doubling. This proposal is for the supported ordinary frame-counting legacy OMF forms. Distinct field-sampled forms need a separately verified supported mapping before any frame conversion.
bellaProposal.otherClocks: Do not replace unusable video descriptor rate with own CPNT:EditRate, master/project/sequence rate, audio sample frequency, source timecode FPS, DFflag, codec marketing name, or resolution suffix.
bellaProposal.independentAvailability: Usable Frame Rate does not require Length, displayclock, source timecode or DFflag. A damaged/missing Length can leave Duration unavailable while Frame Rate remains usable.
bellaProposal.audio: Visible Frame Rate remains blank for Audio. Its internal Duration display EditRate is a separate fact; audio Sample Rate review is separate.

findings.finding: Current OMF Frame Rate uses the qualified physical video descriptor’s MDFL:SampleRate. The same parsed fraction is used by Duration, but Frame Rate does not require a usable Length. The rate is numeric, not text. No file/master CPNT EditRate, project rate or timecode FPS fallback supplies this video column.

OMF audio descriptor rate supplies the separate Sample Rate field, not Frame Rate. Audio own CPNT:EditRate is used only for Duration display in the already approved design. This audit establishes the OMF contribution, not that unrelated contradictory sources can never create an existing final-row value.

Current OMF projection does not halve or double SampleRate when FrameLayout is interlaced/separate/mixed fields. Layout adjusts picture height and naming geometry, not temporal count units. Do not add a generic interlace-halving rule. A different field-sampled layout requires explicit evidence rather than a filename/layout guess.

Current legacyDnxNamingRate maps selected2997/100 or23976/1000 profiles to1001-based operating points only for codec branding. It leaves FrameRate and Duration raw. This is useful tested compression behavior but is not the general AvidDurationInterpreter already approved for Bella timing.

Current row retains exact frameRateRatio and an eager frameRate string. Adapter converts fraction to double, formats3decimals and strips zeros/dot. Table/CSV use the string. Sorting parses that rounded string back to double, then text breaks ties; distinctions lost in label rounding are not recovered from the retained fraction.

Reuse current correct physical ownership, raw fraction retention, independent-of-Length availability, audio separation and no blanket field-rate transform. Bella should apply its already approved source/type-qualified Avid video rate interpretation once for shared Duration/FrameRate meaning, keep raw words, generate labels at presentation and sort numerically from the exact interpreted rate. No additional decoder/graph or repeated read is needed solely for this field.

A direct genuine OmfReader AVHD220 conditional assertion verifies the authored expected raw2997/100 fraction. The14case DNx decimal matrix and damaged-rate tests defaultMDB, not direct OMF. Direct native WAVE tests assert no FrameRate observation. All were inspected only; no exhaustive OMF rate/layout matrix, actual UI comparison or measured improvement is claimed.

minimalBellaProposalAwaitingApproval: Reuse the safely owned video descriptor SampleRate already read for Duration. Preserve typed raw numerator/denominator and established byte order; use the same agreed exact Avid interpretation as Duration for qualified ExactEditRate forms, without approximate snapping or changing arbitrary Rational meaning.

Known physical video Frame Rate can remain available when Length/Duration is unavailable. Do not infer from master/file editing clocks, TCCP FPS, project rate, filename or compression branding. Audio’s Frame Rate stays blank, even though audio needs its separate own editing rate for Duration display.

Preserve current direct frame-unit behavior for supported OMF layouts. Do not halve/double merely for interlace/field storage. Keep geometry and contextual DNx naming helpers separate from the actual temporal rate.

Keep one compact numeric rate/source context; generate familiar labels such as25,29.97,23.976 when shown/exported, and sort using the exact interpreted numeric fraction rather than the rounded label. Uncommon display precision remains the existing presentation detail, not a new broad rounding rule.

Missing/damaged/ambiguous unsupported rate supplies no OMF Frame Rate; retain physical row and independent fields. Preserve same-priority conflict and expected typed width/status handling. No extra file opening or source-priority change introduced by this field review.

rootCurationProgram.source:
"""Curate OMF Frame Rate evidence by reuse; no media or runtime operations."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def record(path):
    path = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(path)}

receipts = {}
receipt_files = {}
verified = {}
captures = {}
unavailable = []

def check(path, expected, context):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute():
        p = ROOT/p
    if not p.is_file():
        unavailable.append({'path': str(p), 'expectedSha256': expected, 'context': context})
        return
    actual = sha(p)
    assert actual == expected, (str(p), expected, actual)
    verified[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'bytes': p.stat().st_size}
    if str(p).startswith('/private/tmp/') and p.suffix == '.txt' and p.stat().st_size <= 200000:
        captures[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'text': p.read_text()}

def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'),
                       ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                check(value[pk], value[hk], context)
        for key, child in value.items():
            walk(child, context+'/'+str(key))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            walk(child, context+'/'+str(index))

for who in ['mc', 'mdvx', 'current']:
    path = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-frame-rate-'+who+'-20261024/findings.json')
    receipts[who] = json.loads(path.read_text())
    receipt_files[who] = record(path)
    walk(receipts[who], who)

current = receipts['current']
for relative, expected in current['sourceHashesSha256'].items():
    path = ROOT/relative
    check(str(path), expected, 'current/sourceHashesSha256')
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:'+relative], cwd=ROOT) == path.read_bytes()
for anchor in current['anchors'].values():
    lines = (ROOT/anchor['path']).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    excerpt = ''.join(lines[anchor['startLine']-1:anchor['endLine']]).encode()
    assert hashlib.sha256(excerpt).hexdigest() == anchor['excerptSha256'], anchor

range_checks = []
constant_checks = []
mdvx = receipts['mdvx']
with Path(mdvx['binary']['path']).open('rb') as stream:
    for method in mdvx['freshFunctions']+mdvx['reusedFunctions']:
        stream.seek(method['binaryOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(method['codeBytes'])
        assert len(raw) == method['codeBytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == method['codeSha256']
        range_checks.append({'symbol': method['symbol'], 'binaryOffset': method['binaryOffset'],
                             'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': method['codeSha256']})
    for value in mdvx['compiledDictionary']['doubleConstants']:
        stream.seek(value['fileOffset'])
        assert stream.read(value['bytes']).hex() == value['rawHex']
        constant_checks.append(value)

duration_path = ROOT/'Project Bella/evidence/omf-duration-2026-10-24.json'
duration = json.loads(duration_path.read_text())
